dog.description_text:
🍯 Meet Honeybee! 🐝

At just 8 weeks old, Honeybee has proven that she’s as sweet as her name suggests!

Honeybee is a happy, sweet and playful little girl who loves to both give and receive affection and adores being around other dogs.

True to her nature, Honeybee is happy to befriend all humans alike including children!

Honeybee is doing great with her crate training and does just fine being left alone for short periods of time - especially when she's in the company of a cozy bed to snooze ory toys to keep her busy while you are away.

Rather than being food motivated, Honeybee is a true people pleaser who gains all of her motivation by praise and acknowledgment when she listens and takes directions. Honeybee loves the companionship she has with her people and is happy to learn all the ways she can grow into the best dog ever.

Like a typical puppy, Honeybee is looking for a family who understands that she’s still learning and is open to providing continued . patience, consistency, guidance, and tons of love as she grows into the amazing dog she’s meant to be.

Whether you’re a family with kids, other dogs, or simply looking for a happy little sidekick, Honeybee could be the perfect addition to your home!
dog.name: HoneyBee
